cases.command: ITEMS_FILE=data/check-add.jsonl node src/cli.mjs add buy milk

isolated=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R src "$isolated/src" && mkdir "$isolated/data" && env -u ITEMS_FILE node "$isolated/src/cli.mjs" add exercise && ITEMS_FILE= node "$isolated/src/cli.mjs" add walk && cat "$isolated/data/items.jsonl"

isolated=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R src "$isolated/src" && mkdir "$isolated/data" && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-add-relative.jsonl node "$isolated/src/cli.mjs" add from-cwd && cat data/check-add-relative.jsonl && test ! -e "$isolated/data/check-add-relative.jsonl"
